certifiedServices.serviceDescription:
The public certification data surface. Publishes the signed certification package, this
overview, the policy and procedure catalog and the recurring reports, with per-document
publication controls and an access log.

The FedRAMP 20x Key Security Indicator (KSI) validation engine. Runs automated validators
against the provider's live cloud environment across all ten indicator families and records
the evidence each indicator was graded on.

Vulnerability detection and response. Ingests vulnerability findings, applies the provider's
risk model to prioritise them, and tracks remediation against the FedRAMP timeframe
requirements.

Significant change notification (SCN). Records significant changes, runs the required
evaluation, notifies as the rules require and keeps the twelve-month archive.

Assembles the reports FedRAMP 20x mandates from the other modules' data and publishes them as
signed, machine-readable artifacts.

The document library. Holds the policies, procedures and evidence records the FedRAMP rules
require, with version history, an approval workflow, per-document publication control and
training records.

Reporting. Generates and schedules the recurring reports a provider and its agencies need from
the compliance, vulnerability and change data, and keeps the run history.

In-product messaging. Lets a provider's team and its assessors discuss findings, changes and
documents alongside the records they concern, and retains those messages.

serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
Northwatch is a FedRAMP 20x trust center platform. It runs continuous automated validation of
the FedRAMP 20x Key Security Indicators against a provider's live cloud environment, normalizes
the output of disparate security scanners into one FedRAMP-aligned data model, and publishes the
resulting certification data as signed, machine-readable artifacts on a public trust center.

It covers continuous indicator validation and evidence collection, the document and evidence
library, vulnerability detection and response, significant change notification, recurring
reporting, in-product collaboration, and the certification data service that assembles and
publishes the artifacts FedRAMP 20x requires. The certified services are listed below, each
with its security category.

additionalRepositories.accessRequestInstructions: Email the security contact listed in this overview to request access to the document library.
additionalRepositories.repositoryDescription: The Northwatch document library: the system authorization documentation, policies, procedures, plans and assessment reports for the offering, each held as a versioned, approved record.

secureConfigurationGuidance.repositoryDescription: Secure configuration guidance for the offering. Held in the authenticated document library rather than published publicly; agencies and assessors are granted access on request.
